name: Arab-Hebrew Theatre of Jaffa (Al-Saraya)
known: Artistic directors named on Wikipedia: Mohammad Bakri, Yigal Ezrati and Gabi Eldor, with Adib Jahshan directing the Arab company.

name: Israel Museum
known: Jacob (Yasha) Grobman became director on 1 March 2026, after interim director Suzanne Landau (Wikipedia).

name: Petach Tikva Museum of Art
known: Drorit Gur Arie was director and chief curator from 2000 to 2019.
Reut Ferster has been director and Dr.
Irena Gordon chief curator since 2020.
The complex also holds the Yad Labanim house for the city's fallen soldiers, the Founders Museum, the Oded Yarkoni Archives, the Institute of Visual Art and an auditorium.

The association's board lists Reut Ferster as chairwoman, with Irena Gordon, Orit Hasson Walder, Irit Levin, Ziv Barnea, Hezie Lavi, Lisa Shiloach-Uzrad, Sigalit Ben Hayoun, Revital Peretz Ben-Asher and Rachel Shaul Danzig as members (the museum's Friends page).
The Friends association board is listed with Reut Ferster as chair.

name: Tel Aviv Museum of Art
known: The director rejected cancelling exhibitions.

name: GAMeC
known: Director: Lorenzo Giusti (gallery website).

name: MAMbo
known: Lorenzo Balbi became artistic director of MAMbo and head of the Modern and Contemporary Art area of Istituzione Bologna Musei on 3 July 2017.

name: Museion
known: Became a private-law foundation in 2006, with the Autonomous Province of Bolzano-South Tyrol and the Museion Private Founders as its founders (Museion website).
Director since June 2020: Bart van der Heide (Museion website).

Museion Private Founders: a group linking the creative sector with private business in South Tyrol, which supported the Museion Art Club and, in 2021, the purchase of some artworks (Museion website; activity report 2021).
Museion has been a private-law foundation since 2006, set up by the Province of Bolzano and the Museion Private Founders, the former Museion Association.

name: Fondazione Antonio Ratti
known: The Artists' Research Laboratory (CSAV), founded by Annie Ratti in 1995, takes young international artists each year to work with an invited artist who leads the edition: Hilary Lloyd was the invited artist in 2023 (the foundation's art lab page).

Board of directors: Annie Ratti (chair), Paolo De Santis (vice chair), and members Stefano Baia Curioni, Candido Manzoni, Ambrogio Cremona Ratti, Daria Caccia Dominioni, Viva Ratti Pistoi, Sebastiano Ratti Pistoi and Maria Acqua Marina Ratti Pasek (the foundation's website).
The Ratti Group is chaired by Antonio Ratti's daughter Donatella; he founded the firm Tessitura Serica Antonio Ratti in 1945 (the foundation's website).

name: Fondazione Palazzo Strozzi
known: First president Lorenzo Bini Smaghi, first director James Bradburne.
Arturo Galansino has been director general since 2015 (2025 annual report).

name: Uffizi
known: Simone Verde has been director since January 2024.

name: Fondazione Prada
known: Miuccia Prada and Patrizio Bertelli have co-chaired it since 1995.
Board in 2019: Miuccia Prada (chair), Carlo Mazzi, Giò Marconi, Massimo Sterpi, Cristian Valsecchi, Astrid Regina Welter; directors are unpaid (institutional report).
Miuccia Prada, foundation president, is a Prada Group executive director.

name: Gallerie d'Italia
known: Michele Coppola is general director of the Gallerie and runs Intesa Sanpaolo's Progetto Cultura (Intesa Sanpaolo).

Owned and run by Intesa Sanpaolo under its Progetto Cultura, conceived by Giovanni Bazoli, now honorary chairman, and part of a business plan that commits €1.5 billion to Italian communities by 2027 (Intesa Sanpaolo).

name: Pirelli HangarBicocca
known: Pirelli is listed as founder.
Named for its founder and funder, the tyre maker Pirelli.
Vicente Todolí has been artistic director since 2012.
Board: chairman Marco Tronchetti Provera, with Maurizio Abet, Federica Barbaro, Andrea Casaluci and Ilaria Tronchetti Provera as directors;
No annual report or accounts; the about page names Pirelli as founder, three technical sponsors, and a board with chairman Marco Tronchetti Provera, undated.
